source.citation: Synthetic support tickets authored for this repository; released under MIT with the software.
source.provenance_note: No real user, client, or ticket data. No third-party corpus text. Hostnames and addresses are fictitious and restricted to example.invalid; ids are fictional.

file.format: jsonl, UTF-8, LF line endings, trailing newline

gold_notes.und_is_abstention_target: The 13 'und' rows are the desired-abstention group (8 mixed + 5 error_quote). 'und' is not one of the 100 project language codes.
gold_notes.gold_frozen_before_use: Gold labels are author intent frozen before any model ran; they are never edited to match a prediction.

repeated_titles.note: After the original dataset freeze, an audit found two generic request titles coinciding with the development pool after case/accent normalisation; bodies and selected model inputs remain distinct.

actual_model_input_overlap.basis: normalised chosen model input (extract_ticket_text) compared against the excluded development pool
actual_model_input_overlap.note: Bodies and therefore the real classifier input are disjoint; only the bare titles coincide.

development_pool_not_included.note: The development pool holds 53 distinct scenario families and is deliberately not vendored into this fixture; no family id is shared.

benchmark.purpose: Reproduce a frozen guard-vs-fastText policy definition once on the committed 84 rows.
benchmark.not_a_benchmark_claim: Small n; raw counts only. AI-authored and human UNVERIFIED, so results are directional evidence, never production confidence.
